abort.not_supported: This is not a supported Sonoff device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the address and that port 8081 is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_device_id: A device ID is 10 letters or digits, for example 1000abcdef.
error.invalid_key: This devicekey does not decrypt the device's data.
error.key_required: This device encrypts its traffic, so a devicekey is required.
error.wrong_device_id: A device answered, but it reports a different device ID.

confirm.description: Add Sonoff device {device_id}? It does not encrypt its traffic, so no devicekey is needed. Anyone on your network can control it.

data_description.device_key: A secret per device, stored in Home Assistant. See the integration's README for how to get it.

device_key.description: Device {device_id} encrypts its traffic. Enter its devicekey.
device_key.title: Devicekey required

reauth_confirm.description: The stored devicekey for {device_id} no longer works. This usually means the device was paired again. Enter the new key, or leave it empty if the device is now in DIY mode.
reauth_confirm.title: Update devicekey

data_description.device_key: Leave empty only if the device does not encrypt its traffic.

data_description.device_id: The 10 characters shown in the eWeLink app's device settings.
data_description.device_key: Required for devices not in DIY mode, including the S60TPF.
data_description.host: IP address of the device. Reserve it in your DHCP server.

user.description: Add a Sonoff device by its address.

command_failed.message: The device did not accept the command: {error}

data_description.capture_payloads: Keep the last 200 redacted TXT and HTTP frames in the diagnostics download. Use this to report parsing problems. Keys, Wi-Fi details and addresses are removed.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to ask for fresh readings. A poll can be a write to the device, so avoid very short intervals.
